# netbox_bookmark (Resource)

A bookmark marks an object for a user, so that the user finds it again on the dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_site" "example" {
  name = "Example site"
  slug = "example-site"
}

resource "netbox_bookmark" "example" {
  object_type = "dcim.site"
  object_id   = netbox_site.example.id
  user_id     = netbox_user.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_id` (Number) The ID of the bookmarked object.
- `object_type` (String) The object type of the bookmarked object, for example `dcim.site`.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user who has the bookmark.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_bookmark.example 1
```
